Name: Riley - Custom NPC for 1.6
Author: awillowwisp
Description:
[size=3]Riley's back! 
So I managed to get in contact with EssGee, and they granted permission to make an update!!!

Meet Riley! They're a genderfluid young person who has recently moved to Pelican Town from the big city. Friendly and upbeat,
they'll be eager to befriend you right away, but if you're looking to date them, that may take a little more effort.[/size]

[size=3](You can find their house in the area between JojaMart and Clint's Workshop)[/size]

[size=5][b]Events:[/b][/size]
[size=3]The events can only be triggered in order, excluding their 6-heart event which
isn't required for later events. Other requirements are listed below.[/size]
[spoiler]

[size=3][b]2 Hearts[/b] - Enter the Saloon between 5pm and 10:30pm.[/size]
[spoiler]
﻿[size=3]Riley will greet you, then ask if you're curious yet about their gender. If
[/size][size=3] ﻿you correctly assume they're genderfluid, they're pleased; with any
[/size][size=3] ﻿other option, they explain that they are and a little more about their
[/size][size=3] ﻿general feelings toward gender. No matter what, they'll then ask what
[/size][size=3] ﻿they are right now. You can answer or tease them that 'what they are' is
[/size] [size=3] ﻿slightly drunk. The conversation moves on, and the event trails off.[/size]
[/spoiler]

[size=3][b]3 Hearts [/b]- Enter Sam's house at any time; you must have seen Sam's 2-heart event.[/size]
[spoiler]
﻿[size=3]You find Riley listening to Sam and Sebastian practice, saying you must
[/size][size=3] ﻿have given the band good advice. As Riley is leaving, they stop to talk
[/size][size=3] ﻿to you, but are distracted by an announcement about some singer named
[/size][size=3] ﻿Alanna on the radio. They leave, and you follow them outside. They
[/size][size=3] ﻿confess Alanna is their older sister and that they had wanted to be a
[/size][size=3] ﻿famous singer too, but failed. You help them cheer up, though.[/size]
[/spoiler]

[size=3][b]4 Hearts[/b] - Enter Riley's house between 7pm and 10:50pm[/size]
[spoiler]
﻿[size=3]It's just Netflix and chill, that's it that's the event lol. But in all
[/size][size=3] ﻿seriousness, Riley invites you to watch a movie, and afterward makes a
[/size][size=3] ﻿pass at you. If you don't immediately reject them, they'll invite you to
[/size] [size=3] ﻿stay the night, which you can do or turn down. As long as you don't
[/size][size=3] ﻿reject the initial flirting, though, you can actually sleep in their bed
[/size] [size=3] ﻿from then on if you want.[/size]
[/spoiler]

[size=3][b]6 Hearts [/b]- Enter Town between 9am and 4pm on a Sunny day; you must NOT have completed the Community Center or Joja Membership![/size]
[[b]WARNING[/b]: This is a LONG event; it can take around 10 minutes to complete. If
playing Multiplayer, either do it earlier in the day or have a mod that
pauses time.]
[spoiler]
﻿[size=3]You find Riley, Sam, and Abigail setting up for a LARP session, and are
[/size][size=3] ﻿invited to join. Riley helps you make a character, giving you options
[/size][size=3] ﻿for class, background, and personality. After that, you, Riley, and
[/size][size=3] ﻿Abigail face off against 3 villain encounters played by Sam, and one of
[/size][size=3] ﻿the traits you chose will give you a unique option each encounter. There
[/size] [size=3] ﻿are two chances to "fail" depending on what you chose, but no matter
[/size][size=3] ﻿what everyone has fun.[/size]
[/spoiler]

[size=3][b]8 Hearts[/b] - Enter the Bus Stop between 7am and 2pm on a Sunny day[/size]
[spoiler]
﻿[size=3]You find Riley walking through the Bus Stop when something alarms them.
[/size][size=3] ﻿Soon, their sister Alanna approaches from the direction of the bus. You
[/size][size=3] ﻿can either lie for them or encourage them to talk to her; while the
[/size][size=3] ﻿latter annoys them, neither has an effect on friendship. Alanna and
[/size][size=3] ﻿Riley wind up talking and learning some things about each other, and
[/size][size=3] ﻿Alanna reveals she's come to ask Riley to do professional art for her.
[/size][size=3] ﻿The player can encourage Riley in a few different ways. Riley accepts
[/size][size=3] ﻿the offer and seems to make up with Alanna.[/size]
[/spoiler]

[size=3][b]10 Hearts[/b] - Part 1 - Exit the Farm House on a Sunny day that is NOT a Festival.
Riley will be there and ask you to come to the beach later.[/size]

[size=3][b]10 Hearts[/b] - Part 2 - Enter the Beach between 5pm and 11pm on a Sunny day that is NOT a Festival (can be the same day as part 1)[/size]
[spoiler]
﻿[size=3]Riley has something they want to tell you, but can't seem to get it out. They
[/size] [size=3] ﻿sing you a song Alanna helped them write, but trail off at the
[/size][size=3] ﻿end. You can react in one of a few ways to encourage or discourage their
[/size] [size=3] ﻿feelings.[/size]
[/spoiler]
[/spoiler]

[size=5][b]Compatibility:
[/b][/size]
[size=3]Compatible with all major expansions (ES, RSV, SBV, SVE, SBV, VMV, etc) and pretty much all other NPC mods!
If SVE is installed, Riley's house will be moved a bit to the right.[/size]

[/size][size=5][b]Future Plans:
[/b][/size][size=3] 
[s]Movie Theatre reactions - Courtesy of EssGee these will be added in the next update![/s] (added in version 1.3)

I've been talking to EssGee about the future of Riley, and I've already released the all changes that EssGee intended for Riley.
So I don't know if there will be more content for Riley, at the bare minimum I'll continue to maintain this mod and fix any bugs.

If you want to include Riley in any events or dialogue, please refer to the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5811]permissions[/url] EssGee has set on their mod page.

[size=5][b]Notes:[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]When talking about them in the comments, please use they/them pronouns to represent the flexibility of their gender. Thank you!
[*]Their wearing a bikini and wedding dress even on days they identify as male is intentional. Riley is very comfortable with themself, and generally prefers dresses to suits for formal attire.
[*]Since Riley's gender is randomized, sometimes they will be male/female for multiple days straight. After all, it's a 50/50 chance every day.
[*]If you need to contact EssGee, they've left [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5811]instructions[/url]﻿ on how to contact them as well as permissions for Riley.
[*]The permissions laid out by EssGee also apply to this mod.
[*]And if you need to contact me, my discord is awillowisp
[*]This is my first time doing anything modding-related, so please don't hesitate to tell me if there are any issues, or how I can do something better!
[/list]
